body: There is actually an LGTM'd (but not pushed yet) fix for this.

I don't know how to re-open, but this only mostly fixed it.  There are a couple of cases not currently covered (at least for Kythe, there may be others):
1. maven_jar still warns
2. http_file still warns
3. git_repository for a repository with a WORKSPACE which doesn't set the name still warns

issue.title: warning about workspace name after upgrading

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
any pointers? thanks!

> WARNING: /home/swang/.cache/bazel/_bazel_swang/0c7c3636aa25cf7b9c5a714c448ab26b/external/local_config_cc/WORKSPACE:1: Workspace name in /home/swang/.cache/bazel/_bazel_swang/0c7c3636aa25cf7b9c5a714c448ab26b/external/local_config_cc/WORKSPACE (@__main__) does not match the name given in the repository's definition (@local_config_cc); this will cause a build error in future versions.

body: 3 is working as intended.  Working on the other two.

That commit doesn't appear to have fixed the issue (unless 4b71d2e1bc3afa0ce0a5b6e68dac3c559654d975 undid it).

```
$ bazel info release
release 0.2.2b-2016-05-03 (@4b71d2e)
$ bazel clean
$ bazel test //...
WARNING: <snip>/external/com_googlesource_code_re2/WORKSPACE:1: Workspace name in <snip>/external/com_googlesource_code_re2/WORKSPACE (@__main__) does not match the name given in the repository's definition (@com_googlesource_code_re2); this will cause a build error in future versions.
WARNING: <snip>/external/com_apache_org_license_2_0/WORKSPACE:1: Workspace name in <snip>/external/com_apache_org_license_2_0/WORKSPACE (@__main__) does not match the name given in the repository's definition (@com_apache_org_license_2_0); this will cause a build error in future versions.
WARNING: <snip>/external/maven_guava/WORKSPACE:1: Workspace name in <snip>/external/maven_guava/WORKSPACE (@__main__) does not match the name given in the repository's definition (@maven_guava); this will cause a build error in future versions.
```

The `@com_googlesource_code_re2` repository was case 3, but `@com_apache_org_license_2_0` is an `http_file`.
@shahms: bazel clean doesn't actually delete the external repositories and the fact that they needed to change wasn't noticed (because of the bug d5512bf fixed).
Thanks, Kristina.  This does appear to be fixed (except for the upstream which has a nameless WORKSPACE, which you've indicated is intentional).
What do you mean, the upstream has a nameless workspace?

I mean the upstream external repository has a WORKSPACE file with no `workspace(name=...)` directive:

https://code.googlesource.com/re2/+/master/WORKSPACE
